browser.isolation: Separate preview output, autosave directory and browser session; forced LLM off with provider stub.
browser.checkpointNote: First native 24-month run, used to compare current renderer on an unchanged world; final accounting qualification uses the later verified checkpoint.

limits: Two-year conservation run, not a 200-year or historical accuracy qualification.
Initial housing capacity and within-parcel building positions remain aggregate assumptions; depicted floor counts are not a technology-calibrated structural engineering model.
Neighborhood activity comes from modeled household-pool employment classification; streets, courtyards and individual building shapes remain a derived view.
No claim that city count must fall; real funded growth and occupied connections determine settlement changes.
The concurrent square-grid migration requires new worlds; old user saves were left untouched.

subsequentSourceChange.reportedChange: The coordinating square-grid chat reports Prettier-only edits to src/sim/corridors.ts and src/sim/transport.ts after qualification completed.
subsequentSourceChange.verificationBoundary: The native run remains bound to its recorded modelHash. This metadata update does not claim a new native run or independently verify equivalence of subsequent edits.
